details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4807, 4842 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Python heredoc blocks with "unexpected indent" syntax errors.
  WHY: Script will fail with parse error when executed, preventing the security-pass functionality from running; other reviewers identified these lines as pre-existing valid heredocs and a scanner false positive.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4231, 4368, 14005 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Security-pass paths call update_completion_status_comment with status token "waiting" while the rendered body reports security-pass or security-pass-fixing.
  WHY: Tooling that parses the HTML status tag sees "waiting" rather than the actual security-pass state, causing incorrect state interpretation; one reviewer judged the existing token vocabulary makes "waiting" correct.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4129-4143, 4168 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: prepare_tracking_judge_checkout leaves the runner on the integration branch and never restores the default branch.
  WHY: Future git-based steps assuming HEAD is the default branch could behave incorrectly, although another reviewer found current API-based paths make this benign.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4572-4575, 13968-14014, 14019-14025 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: When ENABLE_SECURITY_PASS is set to false while a project is already in security-pass or security-pass-fixing state, the project becomes permanently stuck.
  WHY: ensure_security_pass_before_completion returns 0 without clearing those statuses, downstream completion paths and stall recovery exclude them, and /re-security-pass only handles PROJECT_STATUS=failed with ai:security-pass-failed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13985-14014; 11426-11431 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The security-pass-fixing watcher advances only when the fix issue is already closed AND (linked_pr.merged or ai:merged), but security-pass fix PRs targeting the integration branch may not close the issue or appear as merged through the CrossReferencedEvent data.
  WHY: After the consolidated fix PR squash-merges into orchestrator/project-*, linked_pr.merged can be false/null and the fallback depends on external label/issue lifecycle mechanisms; one reviewer found that fallback can converge through ai:merged.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4467, 4547-4552; 8733-8735; 18282-18345 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: A re-audit started from mark_validation_complete always stamps ai:security-pass before the engine returns, which removes ai:validated.
  WHY: If that call does not return success, a later clean pass sets status=in_progress and returns to the main loop instead of resuming finalize_integration_merge_if_needed; one reviewer judged re-dispatching validation after the integration head changes semantically correct.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:security-pass-fixing watcher, `elif [ "${SECURITY_FIX_STATE}" = "closed" ]` branch (lines ~14003-14014) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: When the active security-pass fix issue is closed without merged-PR evidence, the watcher executes continue with no counter, escalation, or recovery path.
  WHY: The project wedges in security-pass-fixing forever; /re-security-pass cannot rescue it because it requires PROJECT_STATUS=failed plus the ai:security-pass-failed label.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4377; 14019-14028 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: On engine_unavailable failures, the next poll tick re-runs the entire security audit without an attempt counter, backoff, or cycle cap.
  WHY: A persistent engine outage burns a full xhigh audit every ~5-minute tick per stuck project indefinitely while the tracking issue never advances.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "With the flag on, prove all four completion routes are blocked until a clean current-head pass; synthesized clean completion enters the pass"
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py sandbox tests for judge-complete with validation enabled and disabled, external-finalize, merge-conflict, and mark_validation_complete completion routes with enable_security_pass=true and a blocking findings payload
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: The new sandbox tests only drive judge-complete with enable_validation="false"; test_security_pass_gate_is_present_on_every_completion_route is a source-grep assertion, not a sandbox execution that asserts the project status stays gated when findings exist; no test sets enable_security_pass=true on the validating, external-finalize, or merge_conflict paths.
- requirement: Extend the existing poller sandbox tests to prove flag-off behavior is unchanged on every touched completion path.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py sandbox runs of judge-complete with ENABLE_VALIDATION=true, external-finalize, merge_conflict, and mark_validation_complete with enable_security_pass=false
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: The only flag-off sandbox test is test_security_pass_flag_off_preserves_legacy_completion_route, which covers judge-complete with enable_validation=false; no new test asserts the other three gated routes still complete when the flag is off.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
(No findings reported.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4467 (set_tracking_phase_label "ai:security-pass" inside run_security_pass_inline) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: run_security_pass_inline unconditionally calls `set_tracking_phase_label "ai:security-pass"` BEFORE invoking the audit engine, which removes any currently held `ai:validated` label.
  WHY: Once `ai:validated` is removed, mark_validation_complete returns at line 8734 and the outer cycle re-enters only because `has_label ... "ai:validated"` is now false; on a clean re-audit the label is never reapplied.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4231, 4368, 14005 (update_completion_status_comment "waiting" calls inside security-pass helpers) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: All three security-pass helper paths call `update_completion_status_comment "waiting"` while the rendered body states security-pass or security-pass-fixing.
  WHY: The helper writes `<!-- status:waiting -->`, so downstream tooling sees waiting rather than the security-pass state and the canonical token contract is silently violated.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4572-4575 (ensure_security_pass_before_completion early return) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: When `ENABLE_SECURITY_PASS=false`, the function returns 0 without transitioning `status` away from `security-pass` or `security-pass-fixing`.
  WHY: Downstream completion paths exclude those states, the stall detector skips them, and `/re-security-pass` only handles `status=failed` with `ai:security-pass-failed`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13985-13986 (security-pass-fixing watcher) | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The watcher advances only when the fix issue is closed AND `(linked_pr.merged == true OR has_label "ai:merged")`.
  WHY: Security-pass fix PRs target `orchestrator/project-*`, so linked_pr may be null; the fallback depends on the implement workflow and issue_pr_status.yml setting ai:merged.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:14019-14025 (security-pass re-entry block) | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: When the security-pass gate fails closed, the next poll re-enters the same security-pass block and re-runs the audit.
  WHY: A persistent transient network failure causes a per-tick retry loop with no backoff until another recovery budget is exhausted.
- Requirement: "With the flag on, prove all four completion routes are blocked until a clean current-head pass (judge-complete with validation on and off, external-finalize, merge-conflict, and mark_validation_complete)."
  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py sandbox tests
  Evidence of absence: The new tests all drive judge-complete with `enable_validation="false"`; `test_security_pass_gate_is_present_on_every_completion_route` is only a source-grep assertion.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
